name: clipping-agency-skill
description: Free, open-source clipping agency skill: your AI agent keeps one folder per client, cuts each episode into vertical clips in the client's brand, checks names, no-go topics, sponsor labels and guest releases in code, gets the client's yes on a phone-friendly approval page, schedules approved clips on the client's own TikTok, Reels and Shorts, and writes a monthly report from real numbers.
